dct_description_sm:
Bandshell seating: painted structures used for sitting, consisting of 10' 1x4 wood fastened to painted steel legs.  Seats 4-5 people.

Bleachers/Ball Diamond Seating: Tiered seating for event spectators.  They are either 10' or 16' long, the 16' bleachers that may be anchored to a hard surface.   They are constructed out of galvanized frames or painted square tubing with wooden steps and seats.

Chess tables: chess tables have a chessboard top and attached seats.

Picnic tables: powder coated metal or painted wooden tables with attached seats. Some are wheelchair accessible. 

Data are updated by city staff as needed, and copied to the Open Data Portal on a weekly basis. The "Last Updated" date shown on our Open Data Portal refers to the last time the data schema was modified in the portal, or any changes were made to this description.  We update our data through automated scripts which does not trigger the "last updated" date to change.

Note: Attributes represent each field in a dataset, and some fields will contain information such as ID numbers.  As a result some visualizations on the tabs on our Open Data page will not be relevant.
